method.integrityMessage: Left null: no separate cryptographic integrity result was transcribed. Preserve Acrobat's displayed alteration wording under modificationMessage; do not infer digest validity from its overall badge.
method.changeCategories: Relevant categories transcribed, not an exhaustive UI transcript. A baseline Square annotation category also appeared in unchanged case 01 and many other cases; recorded in notes instead of attributed to each intended mutation.
method.truncation: An ellipsis in a message explicitly marks text clipped in the UI. Do not treat clipped messages as full quotations.

method.description: Each signature inspected separately. Case 31 was explicitly validated with Validate All Signatures and read in the Signatures panel. Other results were read from the native Signature Properties dialog after clicking Validate Signature. Text is transcribed with surrounding whitespace removed.
method.focusControl: Before using arrow keys in the signature tree, the native context menu was checked for Show Signature Properties. The annotation control was closed without a save prompt and reopened for a clean recheck.
method.screenshots: Inspected in the interactive session; no standalone screenshot evidence files saved.
method.integrityMessage: Left null: an altered/corrupted message is not a separately observed cryptographic digest result. All 25 detached signatures independently verified with OpenSSL.
method.changeCategories: Selected visible categories, not a complete transcript. Empty arrays mean no category was transcribed, not proof that no category exists. In case 44 the page category appears below both signatures despite differing properties results.
method.permissionMessage: Literal UI wording. Approval-signature properties also use the word certifier; this is not evidence that an approval fixture contains a DocMDP transform.
method.trust: Acrobat states that revocation checking is not performed for certificates that were directly trusted.

method.description: All 42 signatures were individually selected and read in native Signature Properties dialogs. Exact status, modification and permission text was transcribed with surrounding whitespace removed. Files were validated on open. Case 83 was reopened and explicitly revalidated with Validate Signature after a conflicting initial panel display.
method.screenshots: Inspected in the interactive session; no standalone Acrobat screenshot evidence files saved.
method.integrityMessage: Left null: the altered/corrupted wording is not a separately observed cryptographic digest result. All 42 CMS signatures independently verify with OpenSSL.
method.changeCategories: Selected visible panel categories, not an exhaustive transcript. Empty arrays mean no category was transcribed, not proof that none exists. Categories are kept separate from Signature Properties verdicts.
method.permissionMessage: Literal UI wording. The word certifier also appears for approval signatures; actual DocMDP and FieldMDP transforms were checked independently.
method.trust: The imported test identity was valid in all properties dialogs. Acrobat reports that revocation checking is not performed for directly trusted certificates.
